# Developer documentation

This area belongs to a concrete game created from Forge2D Template. It is empty
by design until that game has architecture, features, decisions, or plans worth
recording.

- [Feature template](features/_feature-template.md)
- [Decision-record template](decisions/_adr-template.md)
- [Game ExecPlans](plans/index.md) and their

## Inherited Forge2D foundation

The reusable runtime is documented in the
[Forge2D Template runtime overview](../forge2d-template/architecture/runtime-overview.md).
Do not duplicate it here. Document only a concrete game's additions, deliberate
departures, and game-owned architecture.
